“You are reading this book?”

Then I was greatly stunned and entered into great anger, and I said to him:

“This book is holy of holies—what are you saying?”

Then he said to me:

“Animal, you do not know what there is—you know, you know nothing of what there is in the world.

This is one of the Breslov books; it is forbidden to read them.

What? The rav and all the Admo”rim and the whole world oppose it,

and say that it is forbidden, that it is forbidden to read Breslov books.”

For the first time in my life I heard that there is Breslov in the world and that it is forbidden to read the books.

Then I said to him:

“I do not listen to the whole world, to all the Admo”rim. This book is good for me.

I have seen such wonders as are impossible to tell.”

Then he said to me:

“You are such an insolent person, brazen-faced, such a brazen person against the Admo”r and against all the Admo”rim.

Then you are not a human being.”

I said to him:

“For me it is good.”

Then he said to me:

“This book is mine; I want the book.”

I did not want to give it to him. I said to him:

“I acquired it from ownerless property in a garbage bin.”

Then he said to me:

“This book is mine and I want it. I, I do not need it; I only want you not to read it.”

Then he, he overpowered me and took the book from me by force, and I was left without the book, and I was left without the book.

But I heard that there is a Chassidus in the world whose name is “Breslov.”

So I, I was left without the book, but I continued to do hisbodedus, and I prayed to Hashem Yisbarach to have compassion on me as He had begun to help me and I found this book; and I know what, what, what it is, what, what, what...

what it effected in me. So I asked Hashem Yisbarach to send me Breslov books and Breslov Chassidim.

I arrived in Teveria and had not left Teveria. I did not know—Tzfas was close to Teveria.

I thought: perhaps in Yerushalayim, perhaps somewhere in the world Breslov Chassidim can be found. So I asked, and this...

Not much time passed, and Hashem Yisbarach accepted my prayer and sent me to Teveria, sent Rebbe Yisroel Kardonner.

Rebbe Yisroel Kardonner.
